methodology.title: Three principles we hold under pressure.
methodology.lede: What stays true regardless of stack, sector, or team size.

items.title: Audit before architecture
items.body: Two weeks of operator interviews and workflow tracing precede any tooling decision. We start from where the work actually breaks, not from what's fashionable.

items.title: Cost target signed first
items.body: Before code, we agree on the dollar number that justifies the engagement. Every routing rule and model choice ties back to that target — and it's visible on a dashboard you own.

items.title: Handoff that survives us
items.body: Documented runbooks, named owners on your side, and a 30-day shadowing window. The system stays useful when the consultant is gone — that's the only handoff that counts.

team.title: The people who make AX real
team.lede: Strategy, BD, and engineering in one room.

about.title: We don't ship demos. We ship P&L changes.
about.body: Velox BD exists for the hardest part of AI adoption — making it real in day-to-day work. We don't ship demos; we ship changes you can see on next quarter's P&L.
about.quote: We recovered 720 hours per month within eight weeks of going live. The work disappeared, not the people.

items.a: We start at a single 8-week workflow (~$25k+). A separate 2-week audit is available as a standalone.

items.q: Can we adopt this without an internal engineering team?
items.a: Yes. We interview your operators, define requirements, and build and operate the system ourselves. Handoff includes operating documentation.

items.q: Which LLMs do you use? We're worried about lock-in.
items.a: We mix Anthropic, OpenAI, and open-source models per case. Prompts and data are designed to remain portable across providers.

items.q: How do you handle security and data?
items.a: We default to running inside your AWS/GCP environment, sign NDA/DPA, and never use your data for model training.

items.q: Do we keep working with you after launch?
items.a: We continue under a monthly retainer during the Operate stage. You can end it any time once you can run it yourselves.

finalCta.title: Let's talk.
finalCta.lede: Tell us about your operations. We'll see if there's a fit — no pitch, no pressure.

footer.tagline: AX isn't a slogan. It's a change in operations.
